text:
Alex: Quick dump of the RoPE scaling experiments I ran this morning — NTK vs YARN vs linear on Mixtral/Qwen. TL;DR: NTK variant reduces p95 latency but introduces a tiny perplexity blip on longctx Mistral-8k.

Jia: Can you paste the profiler snippet? interested in kernel choices + batch slices.

Alex: Posted the minimal profile below. note: test rig = 4xA10, payload = chat-like 512->2048 tokens, dynamic batching enabled (heuristic v3).
```
2025-11-02 08:12:01 PROFILE SUMMARY
model: mixtral-7b
rope_variant: ntk
kernel: fused_attention_v2 (fallback to generic_attention for >1536 seq)
batching: dynamic_v3 (slice=32/16 adaptive)
kv_cache_hit: 98.6% (prefetch on prefix)
latency_p50: 24ms p95: 138ms p99: 290ms
tokens/s: 18.2k
perplexity_short: 12.3 long: 13.8 (+1.5 vs baseline)
```

Mike: Hmm perplexity bump is small but could correlate with RoPE phase wrap at >1024 in Mixtral. Did you try forcing kernel to linear-rot?

Alex: Yes — when forcing linear-rot kernel we saw latency +40% but perplexity drops back to baseline. That suggests fused_attention_v2's RoPE handling favors speed and might approximate phase wrap differently.

Leah: Any KV cache artifacts? earlier runs showed eviction flutters when batching heuristics changed.

Alex: KV profile shows occasional cache stampede when two longctx requests hit same shard and dynamic batching collapses them into a single slice. Example log: `kv: shard-2 miss-streak=3 -> cold-regen` — added a 12ms jitter reduce and that healed the stampede.

ci-bot: PERF_ALERT: mixtral-7b ntk-rope test on 4xA10 p95 regression > baseline by 10% for small batches (<=4). See run 2025-11-02_0812.

Jia: Interesting. Can you enumerate the actionable knobs we changed for this sweep? I'm thinking we need a small canary before rolling heuristic v3.

Alex: Actionables: [1] pin fused_attention_v2 only for seq<=1536, fallback earlier; [2] reduce dynamic_v3 slice-aggressiveness for concurrent small-batch flows; [3] add tiny KV random delay (6-12ms) on shard hot-paths to avoid stampedes; [4] surface per-model "rope-safe-range" in console (recommended: Mixtral: <=1536 (NTK), Mistral-8k: prefer linear at >2048).

Mike: For the console surface, also include model+kernel mapping and cost delta (tokens/s) + perf risk. Ops wants a checkbox before enabling v3 on Dedicated customers.

Leah: Agreed. Also file an eval run for perplexity on the longctx validation set (2000 samples) for Mistral and Qwen to confirm quality delta <2% before rollout.

Alex: I'll run that eval and push a small PR to guard the kernel selection code (patch: "rope: prefer linear kernel when seq>threshold or model-assert-linear"). posting diffs shortly.

Jia: Thanks. Can you attach the run id and a short repro command? We'll coordinate a canary with infra.

Alex: Run id: run-20251102-ntk-mixtral-v3. Repro command: `python tools/run_perf.py --model mixtral-7b --rope ntk --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --batch-heuristic dynamic_v3 --profile`

Mike: Sweet. After the eval, let's schedule a 30m triage tomorrow to decide the safe ranges and default kernel map.

Leah: +1. If we pick conservative defaults we can A/B test later with traffic shaping. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: NOTE: scheduled perf triage meeting created: meeting-1759995600.

Alex: Cool — I'll upload the full logs and the short eval summary to the thread when ready. Thanks all.
